_what: C-9 T10-2 step 3 (a): the hero identity plates, cut from the paint-over by the ID render
_use: Each plate is the piece's painted look from the PLAY CAMERA. To put it on a hero model, bake it exactly as the character was: nb_t8/scripts/t5_06a_surface.py for the model at its blockout transform (world space), then t5_06b_bake.py with ONE sheet whose single cell is this plate's `cell` (the painting cropped to rect) and whose matte is the plate's alpha. Weight = texel density x facing^4, averaged in linear light, unseen texels filled inside their UV island. Or project at run time: plate px = cell camera applied to the fragment's world position.

camera.px_from_world: x = (p.u_hat - u0) * px_per_m ; y = (v1 - p.v_hat) * px_per_m * sin(pitch) - p.y * px_per_m * cos(pitch)
